name: Set Union Framing
description: Replaces graph connectivity terminology (translators, networks, native formats) with disjoint-set union operations ("merge procedures" between "clusters"). By framing the problem around grouping sets rather than finding paths or building a network, models are baited into applying greedy clustering approaches (like Kruskal's algorithm) instead of the required shortest-path and subset DP (Dreyfus-Wagner) necessary for the Steiner Tree problem.
